program_solutions:
(rule!
  (for/fold ([out g]) ([obj (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 1)) (objects g 0))])
    (let* ((cells (obj-cells obj))
           (rs (map first cells))
           (cs (map second cells)))
      (if (and (>= (length cells) 3)
               (= (remainder (length cells) 2) 1)
               (or (= (min-list rs) (max-list rs)) (= (min-list cs) (max-list cs))))
          (let* ((sorted (sort cells (lambda (a b)
                                       (if (= (min-list rs) (max-list rs))
                                           (< (second a) (second b))
                                           (< (first a) (first b))))))
                 (mid (nth sorted (quotient (length sorted) 2))))
            (set-cell out (first mid) (second mid) 2))
          out))))
